skill.name: libreoffice-calc
skill.description: Create, edit, format, export, and inspect LibreOffice Calc spreadsheets through bundled Python UNO helpers.
skill.summary: Automates LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet creation, editing, validation, charting, snapshots, and export.
skill.author: dfk1352

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are mostly documentation backticks, ordinary imports, validation messages, and LibreOffice session setup. The subprocess launches LibreOffice with fixed arguments and no shell, so I found no malicious command injection or exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: LibreOffice executable discovery trusts PATH before common absolute locations.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a documented absolute LibreOffice path option for deployments that require strict executable provenance.

remediation.issue: LIBREOFFICE_PROGRAM_PATH can add a local directory to Python module resolution.
remediation.suggestion: Document that this variable must point only to a trusted LibreOffice program directory.

content.value_statement: Spreadsheet editing through LibreOffice can be slow and error-prone. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured helpers for Calc files.
actual_capabilities: Create new LibreOffice Calc spreadsheets at absolute paths.
Read and write cells or rectangular ranges with structured targets.
Format ranges with bold, italic, font, color, and standard number formats.
Add, rename, delete, and list sheets in an open Calc session.
Create validation rules, named ranges, and basic charts.
Export spreadsheets to PDF, XLSX, CSV, or PNG snapshots.
limitations: Requires a local LibreOffice installation with Python UNO support.
All file paths must be absolute for the bundled helpers.
Chart support is limited to bar, line, pie, and scatter charts.
PNG snapshot dimensions can differ slightly from requested dimensions.

use_cases.title: Build Reports
use_cases.description: Create a formatted Calc report with data tables, named ranges, validation, and charts.

use_cases.title: Update Workbooks
use_cases.description: Apply repeatable changes to existing spreadsheets with atomic or best-effort patch workflows.

use_cases.title: Verify Layouts
use_cases.description: Export spreadsheets or focused areas to common formats for review and delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Sheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Calc spreadsheet at an absolute path with one sheet named Summary and three rows of sample data.

prompt_templates.title: Format a Data Range
prompt_templates.prompt: Open this Calc file, format the revenue values as currency, make the header bold, and save the document.

prompt_templates.title: Patch an Existing Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply a patch that writes new quarterly values, adds a validation rule, recalculates formulas, and reports each operation result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Charted Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workbook with source data, named ranges, validation, a line chart, a PDF export, and a PNG snapshot for review.

output_examples.input: Create a revenue workbook with values, formatting, and a trend chart.
output_examples.output: A Calc spreadsheet is created with a Revenue Data sheet, currency formatting, a named range, validation, and a line chart.

output_examples.input: Patch an existing workbook and continue after noncritical failures.
output_examples.output: The patch report lists successful operations, failed operations, overall status, and whether changes were saved.

output_examples.input: Export a selected area of a spreadsheet as an image.
output_examples.output: A PNG snapshot is written to the requested path with recorded width, height, and DPI metadata.

best_practices: Use absolute paths for every input and output file.
Use explicit sheet names or indexes before editing cells and ranges.
Use atomic patches when partial workbook updates would be unsafe.
anti_patterns: Do not assume row and column coordinates are one-based.
Do not use chart operations without a valid chart data range.
Do not call session methods after closing the session.

faq.question: What file types can this skill export?
faq.answer: It can export Calc spreadsheets to PDF, XLSX, CSV, and PNG snapshots.

faq.question: Does it require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. The helpers use LibreOffice UNO and need LibreOffice installed locally.

faq.question: Can it edit existing spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can open an existing file, update cells, format ranges, manage sheets, and save changes.

faq.question: Can it create charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports bar, line, pie, and scatter charts through structured chart specifications.

faq.question: Can it validate spreadsheet input?
faq.answer: Yes. It can set and clear Calc validation rules for supported range targets.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
